Kestrel Ridge Analytics
Security Whitepaper 2026  |  Document ref KR-DOC-4410
1. Overview
Kestrel Ridge Analytics provides a customer analytics platform for retail and fintech brands.
Customers share loyalty, transaction and engagement data with us through a secure upload or
API, and we return segments, churn scores and campaign insights. This paper summarises how we
protect that data.

2. Data protection
Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or later.
Encryption keys are managed in our cloud provider's key management service and rotated
annually.

3. Access control
Production access requires single sign-on with hardware security keys. Access is reviewed
quarterly and removed within one working day when staff change roles or leave.
